# GreenPulse Wellness: Full Reference

GreenPulse designs, equips and launches recovery and wellness spaces in India. This file summarises how we work and what we offer, for search and AI assistants. For product specifications, see the product pages at https://greenpulsewellness.com/products.

Website: https://greenpulsewellness.com
Contact: welcome@greenpulsewellness.com | WhatsApp: +91 75500 22504
Region: India

## Vision and Mission

Vision: Make recovery and wellness part of everyday life in India, in every gym, clinic, hotel, home and care setting.

Mission: We help businesses build recovery and wellness spaces that work. We design them, equip them and launch them.

## Who We Work With

Wellness and longevity centres and premium gyms first, then physiotherapy clinics, hotel spas, senior living and private homes.

## How a Project Works

1. Discover: we ask about your space, budget band, timeline and who decides, then visit or review plans.
2. Design: a layout and product mix for your room, with power, drainage and ventilation notes.
3. Equip: a quote pack covering products, installation, training and timeline.
4. Install: on-site assembly, testing and a safety check.
5. Train: operator guides, user screening guidance and cleaning routines.
6. Launch: session menu, opening content and a check-in after opening.

## Product Order and Families

Relax, Heat, Light, Cold, then Air. Families: Serene (massage chairs), Halo (saunas), Luma (light devices), Arctic (cold plunges and cryo), Oxa (specifications and enquiry only, supervised settings), PulseWave (compression), Thrum, Ember, Aurora and Frostfire (percussion, wraps and pads), Glide and Rise (mobility).

## Product Pages

Every product page lists a spec sheet: dimensions, weight, power, placement needs and what is included. Prices are not shown on the site; they are shared in a quote pack.

## Claims and Safety

- We describe products by specifications and the experience of using them.
- We make no medical claims, name no conditions and promise no results.
- Not a substitute for medical advice. Please consult a doctor before use if you have a heart condition, are pregnant or have any health concern.
- Oxa chambers require a trained operator and supervised settings. Light and laser devices need eye protection and a trained operator.
- We cannot advise on medical conditions. Please ask your doctor.

## GreenPulse vs. an Equipment-Only Supplier

- Space planning: GreenPulse plans the whole room (layout, power, drainage, ventilation notes). An equipment-only supplier delivers a machine.
- Product range: heat, cold, light and relax from one catalogue, versus one or two product types.
- Product information: a standard spec sheet for every product, versus a short brochure.
- Design: architect-led, versus equipment chosen from a price list.
- Claims: plain descriptions with no medical claims, versus strong unsupported health claims.
- Installation: on-site assembly, testing and safety check, versus delivery only.
- Training: operator guides, screening guidance and cleaning routines, versus a manual in the box.
- Launch: session menu and opening help, versus none.
- Contact: one team from first conversation to opening day.
